messages.author: Matthew Guberman-Pfeffer
messages.body:
Dear AMBER Community,
I�m trying to use CPPTRAJ to quantify salt bridges. Dan previously suggested on a post that the hbond command can probably be used for this purpose. What do you specify for donorhmask in that case since it has to have a 1:1 correspondence with donormask?
Best,
Matthew

messages.author: Daniel Roe
messages.body:
Hi,
Just think of it like a solute-ion calculation with 'hbond' and have
'donorhmask' be the same as 'donormask'; make sure the angle
calculation is disabled (i.e. set 'acut' less than zero).
Hope this helps,
-Dan
